answers.core:
Bit-wise conversion functionality should be the "first class support" not the external library or extension.

To improve performance one can consider making an SSBO/push_constant class as an extension/library in C++ instead of GDScript, though, which does not discards the requirement for bit-wise conversion functionality, especially for push_constant which must be low latency.
answers.workaround: Bit-wise conversion will be very complicated  in GDScript in this case. I'm not as advanced in GDScript to say that this is impossible, though I found no easy way here.
